$comment: Page/breakpoint matrix for the visual regression suite. Paths are relative to the published Wix site; the base URL comes from the WIX_SITE_URL env var (capture.mjs) and the baseUrl field here is only a fallback. Slug is the filename prefix for captured PNGs. Breakpoints follow Wix Studio: mobile 320-750 / tablet 751-1000 / desktop 1001+.
